narrative.overview: Bluvana makes small bathrooms easier to use and better to look at. Deep ocean color, dark tile, walnut and saturated vintage photography shape the brand.

rules.name: Architectural Field
rules.body: Blue and green own full regions. Gold stays limited.

rules.name: No Eyebrow
rules.body: Headings stand on their own. Never add a small label above them.

rules.name: Scan First
rules.body: Lead with the benefit and cut everything a shopper does not need.

rules.name: Protected Type
rules.body: Display phrases use deliberate line breaks, scale with their container and remain clear of organic marks.

rules.name: Logo Modes
rules.body: Use light artwork on dark surfaces and dark artwork on light surfaces. Never alter the internal wave layers.

rules.name: Physical Shadow
rules.body: A shadow must describe an object sitting above a surface.

dos: Do let one or two palette colors own whole regions.
Do show the product solving a space problem.
donts: Don't default to generic spa imagery.
Don't use long copy when one benefit line will do.
Don't use em dashes or hyphens in customer facing copy.
